svg.title: Federal Funds Matchmaker for NC DHHS: Solution Architecture (C4 Container)
svg.desc: C4 container diagram. A daily Container Apps Job (11:00 UTC) pulls opportunities from Grants.gov and award history from USAspending.gov, scores them against the NCDHHS Strategic Plan with a hybrid plan-alignment signal (an Azure OpenAI embedding margin against off-topic fields, averaged with TF-IDF word similarity), writes checked AI summaries with Azure OpenAI chat, and stores everything as JSON in Azure Blob Storage. A Flask web app on Azure Container Apps reads Blob and lets the NC DHHS federal-grants coordinator record Pursue, Maybe or Pass decisions. The image is built in Azure Container Registry; logs go to Log Analytics. Planned items (Entra ID sign-in, Key Vault and managed identity, Application Insights, private endpoints, AI Search or Cosmos DB, SAM.gov, email or Teams alerts) are dashed.
svg.text: Federal Funds Matchmaker for NC DHHS: Solution Architecture
Team 14, UNC Solve-a-thon 2026 • C4 Level 2 (Container) with context • As-built (solid) + planned (dashed) • 2026-11-07 • v1.1

g.text: Decisions store a typed name or initials.
Entra ID sign-in is planned (dashed box).

svg.text: Azure subscription unc-sdis-solveathon-team14 · resource group rg-ffm-team14 · region eastus2

g.text: [Container: Azure Container App · Python Flask + gunicorn · MODE=app]
Shortlist + filters, detail (reason, checked quote, score breakdown,
award history, official link), Pursue / Maybe / Pass + note, CSV export,
funding-by-goal, evaluation, run status and agency profile pages
1 vCPU / 2 GiB · 1 replica · external HTTPS ingress → port 8000
Reads and writes Blob only; never calls an AI model
cron 0 11 * * * = 11:00 UTC (6 AM EST, 7 AM EDT)
10% time to apply, 5% funder history · High ≥55, Medium ≥45
Retry 1 · timeout 3600 s · non-zero exit on failure
Summaries for top 40 agency + top 5 research
No tools; cannot act; never sets the score
App + job console logs, access log
[Platform: secrets on the app and the job]
Queued cloud build: az acr build
One-time seed for the agency profile
Notation: C4 model, Level 2 (Container), with people and
external systems for context. Arrows point in the direction
of the request; responses flow back.
Secret values are never shown; they are masked as ****.
TF-IDF = word-based text similarity (see the note in the key).

svg.text: Flow key (set-up, then the daily job, then staff use)

text.tspan: Plan PDF → Team: one-time, hand-built profile agency/priorities.json (20 objectives with page cites, 40 keywords), second review
Team → ACR + Container Apps: queued az acr build --no-logs (image ffm:v2), az containerapp create/update · HTTPS, Azure CLI sign-in
ACR → Web App + Job: pull image ffm:v2 at start · HTTPS, ACR admin username/password (planned: managed identity)
Job → Grants.gov: search2 (all posted + forecasted; 40 keyword searches for the baseline only), fetchOpportunity · HTTPS/JSON, no key
Job → USAspending.gov: award totals and recipients by assistance listing, FY2022-2025, cached · HTTPS/JSON, no key
Job → Azure OpenAI embed: listing text, 20 plan objectives, 10 off-topic field descriptions → 512-dim vectors, cached by text hash · HTTPS, API key
Job → Azure OpenAI chat: listing + matched objective → JSON summary, reason, 2 quotes (checked in Python) · HTTPS, API key
Job ↔ Blob: read caches + earlier results; write profiles, raw/{date}, details, opportunities, scored, alerts, baseline, runs · HTTPS, connection string
Coordinator → Web App: shortlist, Pursue/Maybe/Pass + note, CSV for the weekly leadership email · HTTPS, no sign-in, CSRF token
Leads + leadership → Web App: detail and funding-by-goal pages (routed items arrive via the coordinator) · HTTPS, no sign-in
Labelers → Web App: blind relevance labels on the Evaluation page · HTTPS, no sign-in, typed labeler name
Web App ↔ Blob: read scored, alerts, runs, profile, baseline; write decisions and labels (ETag check), eval sample · HTTPS, connection string
Web App + Job → Log Analytics: console output and gunicorn access log · Container Apps platform
Job → SAM.gov (planned): second opportunity source · would need an API key (store it in Key Vault)
Job → Email / Teams (planned): deadline alerts for new and closing-soon items
Plan alignment = 0.5 × embedding margin + 0.5 × TF-IDF similarity. Margin = similarity to a plan objective minus the best similarity

g.text: to 10 short off-topic field descriptions (e.g. defence, arts, physics). TF-IDF alone if Azure OpenAI is unavailable.
